name: Generation Meets Verification: Accelerating Large Language Model Inference with Smart Parallel Auto-Correct Decoding
notes: SPACE (Smart Parallel Auto-Correct dEcoding) integrates semi-autoregressive inference with speculative decoding. Speedup 2.7x-4.0x on HumanEval-X. Uses specialized semi-autoregressive SFT to enable simultaneous multi-token prediction, plus auto-correct decoding for parallel generation and verification. Accepted at ACL 2024 Findings.
